policies.sampling: First N occurrences of each local variant per retained parent, plus first occurrence of every global local variant, ranked rungs and instruction representatives; ancestors included. Complete selected rung subtrees bypass the quota.
policies.variant: XML path, attribute names/categories, approved technical values or masked datatype identity, collapsed ordered child-name runs, text/CDATAness and text action. Not complete subtree equivalence.
policies.ladder: Retained rung subtrees are complete; whole operands replaced using Stage 4. Number/approved Type retained.
policies.identifiers: Exact whole identifier/reference strings share dummy IDs in this run; no scope/member/reference resolution. Ladder ARG IDs are separate per rung.
policies.numbers: Invented small values; dates fixed to 2000-01-01. Only approved technical literals and numeric rung Number are retained.
policies.datatypes: Stage 3 approved types retained; other names consistently masked. Not all unknown names are user-defined.
policies.payloads: Non-ladder serialized text and ST text replaced by explicit placeholders. Not translated or interpreted.
policies.mappings: Public source/dummy ordinal XML locators only. Private string replacement dictionaries exist only in process memory.
policies.publication: XML then report; files independently atomic. Compare output_sha256 before using a pair after any write error.

limitations: Structural fixture only; controller import and execution semantics are not validated.
Sampled SFC graphs, task references, tag/member links, array dimensions/indices and serialized payloads are not repaired for semantic coherence.
Lexical replacement preserves broad value categories, not every source formatting rule.
Equal shapes do not imply equal behavior. Ordinal locators apply only to this export ordering.
Namespace URIs, original comments/PIs and CDATA segmentation are not retained.
Original XML element and attribute names remain present, as in the reviewed skeleton.
